mainEntity.name: Why are over-the-counter eye drops not curing my dry eyes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial tears provide temporary relief by mimicking your natural tears, but they only address the water layer. They cannot clear the oil gland blockages (MGD) that cause 86% of dry eye cases. Specialized in-office treatments at Riverside Family Eyecare are required to target the root cause.

mainEntity.name: Does IPL or RF dry eye treatment hurt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Most patients describe the Forma RF treatment as feeling like a warm, relaxing facial massage. Lumecca IPL involves a brief sensation often described as a light, warm snap of a rubber band. There is zero downtime.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need before I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many notice a reduction in irritation after their first or second session, a standard protocol typically consists of 4 sessions spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart. This ensures inflammation is thoroughly suppressed and the oil glands are fully rehabilitated.

mainEntity.name: Does health insurance cover advanced dry eye therapies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard major medical and vision insurance plans cover your initial Specialized Dry Eye Assessment . However, advanced in-office procedures like IPL and RF therapy are typically considered elective and are not fully covered. We offer transparent pricing and flexible payment options.

mainEntity.name: Why are over-the-counter eye drops not curing my dry eyes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial tears provide temporary relief by mimicking your natural tears, but they only address the water layer. They cannot clear the oil gland blockages (MGD) that cause 86% of dry eye cases. Specialized in-office treatments at Riverside Family Eyecare are required to target the root cause.

mainEntity.name: Does IPL or RF dry eye treatment hurt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Most patients describe the Forma RF treatment as feeling like a warm, relaxing facial massage. Lumecca IPL involves a brief sensation often described as a light, warm snap of a rubber band. There is zero downtime.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need before I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many notice a reduction in irritation after their first or second session, a standard protocol typically consists of 4 sessions spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart. This ensures inflammation is thoroughly suppressed and the oil glands are fully rehabilitated.

mainEntity.name: Does health insurance cover advanced dry eye therapies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard major medical and vision insurance plans cover your initial Specialized Dry Eye Assessment . However, advanced in-office procedures like IPL and RF therapy are typically considered elective and are not fully covered. We offer transparent pricing and flexible payment options.
